subject.title: fix(agents): stop runs at the critical tool-loop threshold

question: Should `plugins.entries.codex.config.appServer.loopDetectionPreToolUseRelay: false` retain its historical PreToolUse-only opt-out, or become the opt-out for the paired PreToolUse/PostToolUse loop-detection relay?
rationale: Both choices are feasible, but they impose different upgrade-visible behavior on users who already set this documented configuration key; source-level proof is not enough to choose the permanent contract.

options.title: Preserve the narrow opt-out
options.body: Keep `false` disabling only the historical PreToolUse loop-detection relay and ensure documentation plus focused tests describe any independently required PostToolUse relays.

options.title: Adopt paired relay opt-out
options.body: Intentionally define `false` as disabling the paired loop-detection relays, document the upgrade behavior plainly, and add final-head proof for that exact configuration.

recommendation.title: Preserve the narrow opt-out
recommendation.body: Keep `false` disabling only the historical PreToolUse loop-detection relay and ensure documentation plus focused tests describe any independently required PostToolUse relays.
